_about: Home page 'Why it matters'. Every 'text' is copied word for word from the NYBG page or guide named in 'source' (checked 2026-11-03); do not shorten or reword it here. Order = order on the page.

why.label: The forest
why.text: Today this is the largest uncut expanse of New York's original wooded landscape.

why.label: The problem
why.text: Escaping cultivated boundaries, these species outcompete native flora in the 50-acre Thain Family Forest.
why.source: NYBG Invasive Species Immersive Experience Guide, slide 3

why.label: The work
why.text: Management of invasive plant species is carried out by staff with the help of thousands of volunteers including corporate and community groups.

why.label: The result
why.text: Areas managed are then planted with native plants grown from seed collected in the Forest.
